notes: The dative case preposition to is placed on πᾶσιν rather than on τοῖς, since the article's own English is the relativizer that under rule 90 and rule 21 forbids leaving a bare to on it.
γνωστὸν σημεῖον: both words are anarthrous, so the supplied indefinite belongs to the noun and not to the adjective (rule 58).
οὐ δυνάμεθα → cannot stays one aligned unit under rule 39, the single English word spelling both elements solid.
